answer: The ledger holds 20 percent of every payout as a relic, released after five straight honest epochs. A farm spinning up a hundred fresh identities each epoch and vanishing after collecting never sees it; a fifth of its revenue is gone for good. At 500 POA each, a hundred fakes forfeit 10,000 POA every epoch. The ledger tracks each streak; skipping an epoch restarts it at zero, no appeal. Fresh identities pile up like dunes, starting at zero every time, while a vine tended five epochs pays out in full. A farm rotating identities every epoch pays that fifth forever and never catches up.
